device.name: Isaac Lab Locomotion-Go2-Flat quadruped locomotion task

facts.text: The repository is a reinforcement-learning implementation of quadruped locomotion in IsaacLab with sim-to-sim and sim-to-real scripts
The README lists Aliengo, Go2, B2, A2 and HyQReal2 and flat and rough locomotion environment name patterns
Training requires Isaac Lab to be installed first and installs the library with pip install -e source/basic_locomotion_isaaclab
Locomotion-Go2-Flat is registered with entry point LocomotionEnv and the Go2FlatEnvCfg environment configuration
The package top-level __init__ imports .tasks, which runs the gym.register calls
LocomotionEnv subclasses DirectRLEnv imported from isaaclab.envs, so the Gymnasium base and its spaces live in the external Isaac Lab package
LocomotionEnv is the registered entry class
LocomotionEnv takes the environment configuration cfg, an optional render_mode and extra keyword arguments
Go2FlatEnvCfg sets episode_length_s 20.0, decimation 4, action_scale 0.5 and action_space 12
A Go2-Flat observation frame is 52 values: 3 base linear velocity, 3 base angular velocity, 3 projected gravity, 3 command, 12 joint positions, 12 joint velocities, 12 last actions and 4 clock values
The observation history keeps 5 frames and observation_space is multiplied by history_length, so the policy observation is 260 values
SimulationCfg sets dt to 1/200 s and render_interval to decimation
Go2FlatEnvCfg creates 4096 parallel environments
desired_clip_actions is 3.0 and use_filter_actions is True
Before the action is applied, _pre_physics_step clamps it to +/- desired_clip_actions, filters it with alpha 0.8 and scales it by action_scale
The standard observation concatenates base linear velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, commands, joint position deviation, joint velocity, last actions and clock values in that order
The observation history appends the newest frame last and flattens the frames into one vector
LocomotionEnv returns the observations as a dict with common, critic and policy groups; policy is the standard observation
The episode times out when episode_length_buf reaches max_episode_length - 1 and terminates on a base or hip contact force above 1.0
A reset perturbs joint positions uniformly within +/-0.2 of the default and draws a random yaw
The training script launches the Isaac Sim application with AppLauncher
The training script creates the environment with gym.make(task, cfg=env_cfg), so the task needs an environment configuration object
Real-robot control matches the external unitree-ros2-dls ROS 2 repository; hardware transport is not part of this clone
The repository licence is BSD-3-Clause

determinism.notes: reset(seed=...) and cap.world.seed.v1 set the seed of the next reset. The fake's reduced state is fully deterministic and its fixed observation does not depend on the seed; the upstream reset's uniform joint-position noise and random yaw (locomotion_env.py:652-658) are not modelled, and the upstream Isaac Sim environment was not run, so its own determinism is not claimed.

gaps: the fake is an interface stand-in: it models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuator, sensor or noise model, and no command, reward or height scan; the upstream task runs Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab (README_train.md:3), which this package does not install or run, and no simulator run is claimed

the fake serves one environment with a 12-value action and a 260-value policy observation, while the upstream Go2FlatEnvCfg batches 4096 environments (go2_env_cfg.py:337) and LocomotionEnv returns a dict of common, critic and policy observation groups (locomotion_env.py:423-455); only a flat policy-sized Box is represented, and the critic group is not represented

the fake's 260-value observation follows the 52-value frame order of go2_env_cfg.py:173-183 and the 5-frame history of :185-191, but every value except the last-action tail of the newest frame is a fixed placeholder; no robot pose, command, clock, contact or reward is simulated

the fake never terminates or truncates: the episode time limit and the contact-based termination of locomotion_env.py:571-577 are not modelled (the time-limit rule itself lives in the external DirectRLEnv, which the clone does not contain)

the action space of the upstream environment is created by the external DirectRLEnv and was not inspected; the fake exposes an unbounded Box of 12 values and does not reject or clamp, while the clone's own _pre_physics_step clamps to +/-3.0 (locomotion_env.py:322-323 and go2_env_cfg.py:388)
no snapshot or restore: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state and the fake offers none

only the fake backend is declared; opening the registered task through gymnasium.make needs Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab and an environment configuration object (scripts/rsl_rl/train.py:51 and :174), and was not run

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the world state stays readable
